title: 第19章 道歉第20章 性情中人
lines: “宸儿，为父误会你了...这一百两银票的确是你的。”
“还有这件大氅，你三哥跟你闹着玩呢？怎么会真的要你的东西。”
宁自明双手捧着大氅，上面是一张银票，正是宁甘抢走的那张银票。
宁宸并没有接，而是一脑门问号...用奇怪地眼神看着他们。
这些人脑子被门挤了吗？
抢走的东西，竟然又给他还回来了。
“你们三个混账东西，还不给你四弟道歉？”
宁自明回头怒斥。
宁甘三人满脸不爽。
尤其是宁兴和宁茂，恨不得捏死宁宸...因为这个野种，害得他们兄弟二人今天挨了两顿打。
但宁自明的话他们又不敢不听。
宁甘阴沉着脸，道：“四弟，大哥那天是跟你闹着玩的，如果伤害了你，大哥给你道歉，希望你别放在心上。”
宁宸看着他，心里冷笑，闹着玩？我他妈在床上躺了一个月，你跟我说闹着玩？
但他现在还不明白这一家子搞什么鬼？所以也没理会宁甘。
宁兴干巴巴的说句对不起！
宁茂心不甘情不愿地说道：“四弟，我真没想到要你的大氅，就是跟你闹着玩的，你别当真啊。”
宁宸沉默不语，面无表情。
宁自明见状，急忙道：“宸儿啊，都是自家兄弟，有时闹着玩难免会过火...你看他们都跟你道歉了，你就原谅他们吧。”
“你放心，为父跟你保证，以后这种事绝对不会再发生。”
宁宸实在忍不住了，“宁尚书，你们到底想干什么？直说明说吧。”
“宸儿啊，你别误会...以前是为父对你疏于照顾，是为父的错，我保证以后一定会好好待你！”
“你三个哥哥也是真心实意跟你道歉，我们都是一家人，你就原谅他们吧。”
“宸儿，你能不能答应为父一件事？”
宁宸皱眉，“什么事？”
宁自明道：“宸儿，家丑不外扬，就是今天发生的事，能不能别跟别人说...说出去，丢的是我们宁家的人。”
宁宸脑子里闪过一个大大地问号。
宁自明为何一再强调家丑不外扬？
他是害怕谁知道吗？
可这是宁家的家事，就算当今圣上知道也不会理会吧？
真是奇了怪了，宁自明到底在害怕什么？
难道他是害怕这些事传出去，坏了他的名声吗？
宁宸百思不得骑姐。
不过既然宁自明有软肋，他就可以利用。
“宁尚书，这些事我可以不对任何人说，但我有个要求。”
宁自明道：“你说。”
content_en:
"Chen'er, my father misunderstood you...the one hundred taels of silver notes are indeed yours."
"And this big cloak, your third brother is joking with you? How can he really want it from you?"
Ning Ziming held the cloak in both hands, and on it was a banknote, which was exactly the banknote Ning Gan snatched away.
Ning Chen didn't answer, but had a question mark on his forehead...looking at them with strange eyes.
Are these people's brains blocked?
The things that were taken away were actually given back to him.
"You three bastards, why don't you apologize to your fourth brother?"
Ning Ziming turned around and scolded angrily.
Ning Gan and the other three looked unhappy.
Especially Ning Xing and Ning Mao, they wanted to squeeze Ning Chen to death... Because of this bastard, the two brothers received two beatings today.
But they didn't dare not listen to Ning Ziming's words.
Ning Gan said with a sullen face, "Fourth brother, I was joking with you that day. If I hurt you, I will apologize to you. I hope you won't take it to heart."
Ning Chen looked at him and sneered in his heart, are you kidding? I've been lying in bed for a fucking month and you're telling me it's a joke?
But he still doesn't understand what this family is doing? So he ignored Ning Gan.
Ning Xing said sorry dryly!
Ning Mao said reluctantly: "Fourth brother, I really didn't expect to ask for your cloak. I was just joking with you. Don't take it seriously."
Ning Chen was silent and expressionless.
Ning Ziming saw this and said hurriedly: "Chen'er, we are all brothers. Sometimes when we play, we will inevitably go too far... Look, they have all apologized to you, just forgive them."
"Don't worry, I promise you as a father that this kind of thing will never happen again in the future."
Ning Chen couldn't help it anymore, "Ning Shangshu, what exactly do you want to do? Just tell me."
"Chen'er, don't get me wrong...it was my father who neglected to take care of you in the past. It's my father's fault. I promise that I will treat you well in the future!"
"Your three brothers also sincerely apologize to you. We are all a family, so just forgive them."
"Chen'er, can you promise me something as a father?"
Ning Chen frowned, "What's the matter?"
Ning Ziming said: "Chen'er, we don't want to make the family scandal public. Just what happened today, can you please don't tell others... If you tell it, we, the Ning family, will be disgraced."
A big question mark flashed in Ning Chen's mind.
Why does Ning Ziming repeatedly emphasize that family scandals should not be publicized?
Is he afraid of who knows?
But this is a family matter of the Ning family. Even if the current emperor knew about it, he would not care about it, right?
It's really strange. What is Ning Ziming afraid of?
Is he afraid that these things will spread and ruin his reputation?
Ning Chen never thought about riding sister.
But since Ning Ziming has a weakness, he can take advantage of it.
"Ning Shangshu, I don't have to tell anyone these things, but I have a request."
Ning Ziming said: "You say."
